title: The journey, mapped
line: Ten years of projects and lessons
notes: The source closes by mapping its ten lessons to 2016–2025 and extending the monocle cord to 2026. The ring draws clockwise, year nodes and constellation lines appear, then the cord and logo resolve. Click 1 reveals the pixel avatar, two jumps and a fireworks cascade. Click 2 extrudes the same avatar into a rotating voxel figure. The original self-congratulatory label is omitted. The original lesson captions are moved into these notes: VR and theatre; pivoting; inbound work; interdisciplinary teams; tool choices; deposits; R&D budgets; scope boundaries; client experience; community. Use as the wrap-up to the journey, before the final invitation.
suggested_placement: 2016–2026 / journey wrap-up, before the final invitation
adaptation: Source geometry and avatar retained; two click steps preserved; long captions moved to notes and self-congratulatory label removed; vendored Three.js.
